name: epic
description: Type: a large body of work tracked as sub-issues. Apply exactly one type.

name: story
description: Type: one deliverable change with acceptance criteria. Apply exactly one type.

name: bug
description: Type: something that works differently from the PRD or docs. Apply exactly one type.

name: chore
description: Type: upkeep with no user-facing change (deps, tooling, cleanup). Apply exactly one type.

name: area:agent
description: Area: Forge Agent loop, tools, sandbox and models (PRD 6.1).

name: area:web-ui
description: Area: the React web UI in the browser (PRD 6.2).

name: area:board
description: Area: Forge Board kanban workflow (PRD 6.3).

name: area:server
description: Area: local Rust server, API, services and SQLite (PRD 8).

name: area:launcher
description: Area: npx ingenious-forge package and binary launch (PRD 6.2, 8).

name: area:skills
description: Area: project skills in .agents/skills/.

name: area:process
description: Area: how we build Forge: tracking, CI, hooks, agent setup.

name: area:docs
description: Area: PRD, README, AGENTS.md, decision records and reference docs.

name: P0
description: Priority: needed for the first release (MVP). Stories and bugs only.

name: P1
description: Priority: needed for v1.0. Stories and bugs only.

name: P2
description: Priority: later release. Stories and bugs only.

name: size:XS
description: Size: under an hour, one small edit. Stories only.

name: size:S
description: Size: about half a day. Stories only.

name: size:M
description: Size: one to two days. Stories only.

name: size:L
description: Size: too big for one story; split it before starting.

name: blocked
description: Flag: cannot move until a linked issue or outside event resolves.

name: stale
description: Flag: no activity for a long time; confirm it still matters or close it.

name: needs-decision
description: Flag: waiting on a decision record or the maintainer.

name: good first issue
description: Flag: small, well-scoped and a good start for a new contributor.

name: help wanted
description: Flag: the maintainer welcomes an outside contributor taking this.
